question: Why OpenHOI3 planned no Soviet invasion at 04:00 on 17 July 1941 where the original lands the 195. Strelkovaya Diviziya at Trondheim - and so dropped the 173. Strelkovaya Diviziya from Smolensk's split at 06:00.

addresses.name: CountEnemyUnitsInArea
addresses.signature: int __stdcall CountEnemyUnitsInArea(CAIStrategy* strategy, COwnerArea* area, bool uncapped)
addresses.comment: **How strongly an enemy holds an area, as the AI weighs it - not a count of units.** Read whole on the listing 2026-11-15, 0x8A8EF0 to the `ret 0xC` at 0x8A9383 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 100); the earlier account (a count of units at war with us, rebels left out) was a reading of the first loop only and wrong about the rebels. 0 for a null area. (1) **Theirs**: over the area's provinces (COwnerArea +0x24) and each province's units (CProvince +0x2B8), every land unit (slot 15) not ours whose country we are at war with (our CDiplomacyStatus +0x20 by its id) - or that is REB, or we being REB - and that CanFight (slot 33) adds its brigades (CUnit +0x40); A = that sum / 3 (toward 0), at least 1 where the sum is above 0. (2) The floor is 1, or 5 where the area is its controller's (COwnerArea::GetController, the first province's +0x334/+0x338) acting capital's area and A >= 5. (3) **Ours**: B = the brigades of every land unit there not the controller's, at war with the controller (the controller's status +0x20, or REB either side), that CanFight and is our friend (CCountry::IsFriend(us, its tag, false)); and the same over each neighbour area (+0x34, the link's area at +0) whose controller is not the area's and is at war with it (or REB either side) - the units there tested against the area's controller as before. (4) result = A - fistp(float(B x 250 / 1000)) (B / 4 rounded half to even; the fixed product B x 1000 x 1000 / 4000 taken first); **with fewer than 4 provinces and exactly one port (+0x50) it is 2 x A instead**, B ignored. A result above 0 is raised to the floor; below 0 answers 0; above 10 answers 10 unless `uncapped`. Callers: CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion with uncapped false for an enemy area (0x892C0B) and true for each neighbour area held by an enemy in the friendly branch (0x892DBA); CAIUnit::EstimateAreaNeed's enemy-area exit; the transport want over a plan's objectives. Name is BiceLib's.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing; logged at 0x492C22 rva in PlanAmphibiousInvasion for the Soviet Union at 04:00 on 17 July 1941 - Bornholm 2 (one division, one province, one port: 2 x 1), Tromso's area of 108 provinces 1 and Hammerfest's 1, where headquarters stand beside a division in each, a headquarters brigade having no frontage and failing CanFight; OpenHOI3 built to it gives the same three.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion(CEU3AI* ai, void* areasBeingInvaded, CAIUnit* agentOrNull)
addresses.comment: **Makes the CAIInvasion agents.** Read whole on the listing, 0x892190 to the one `ret 0xC` at 0x893C70. Callers: ProcessAI daily at hour id%24 for an AI-run country (agentOrNull = 0, 0x889AB5) and on even hours for each unit agent of the played country (0x889A39). (1) Gates: a played country needs an agent whose unit (slot 74) is set; an AI country needs agentOrNull = 0. Cap = 2 invasions, JAP 8, USA 4: an AI country with MORE than the cap plans nothing; the area loop stops once the count reaches it (no cap with an agent). While the strategy IsPreparingWar: for each Neighbours (+0xFD8) entry it IsPreparingWarWith, return unless we are major (CCountry::IsMajor: is_major or max_ic > 100) and the target is neither; and return while now < that WarTargets entry's date (+0x1C) plus one month. An AI country also returns when every ranked area (+0xC8) is already in areasBeingInvaded (PruneInvasions' list). With an agent, its +0x36C/+0x370 are zeroed. (2) Candidates, over CCountry +0xBAC in order: a unit with oob_level != 0, no agent of its own, whose topmost agent up +0x1E0 answers slot 65 (a CAIUnit) and is agentOrNull when one is given. A division (level 4): >= 2 brigades, not aboard (CArmy +0x300), its area real (slot 0), not landlocked (+0x68), and either in our acting capital's area or its region group (+0x6C) null or 0x80430 says that group borders no enemy; army_role not 5 or 8; organisation share (slot 26) >= 0.8 and strength share (slot 25) >= 0.75; then spare = CountDivisionsInArea(agent, area, , false) - (candidates already taken from that area) - need, need = EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, , , true), halved (toward 0) in the acting capital's area unless COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(area) or 0x817E0(area); taken when spare > 0 or army_role == 7. **The count and the need are kept for one area only** (0x8926D6-0x892756, read 2026-11-15, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 100): made again, with this unit's agent, whenever its area is not the previous unit's, and the candidates taken so far are walked each time and counted off where their area is this one - so an area met again after another is worked out again, by whatever agent its next division answers to. Any other non-theatre unit: a fleet (slot 16) carrying nothing (CNavy +0x2EC < 1) is a transport candidate. No division -> return. lift = UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(transport candidates) (0x1D66D0) - never reduced as invasions take fleets; ref = 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. (3) Over the ranked areas from the head, stopping at the cap or when lift < ref: skip ENG and NZL/CAN/SAF/AST's 'liberation' areas only for dominions before 1942 - the areas of provinces 2613 Paris, 2137 Brugge, 1910 Amsterdam make an ENG/dominion target 'special' in years <= 1941 (dominions skip every area before 1942); GER without an agent skips London's (1964) area in years <= 1942; skip an area in areasBeingInvaded. **The AreaIsConnectedTo test at 0x892B9E is dead**: it is asked of g_null_owner_area, whose slot 0 answers false. Enemy area (first-province controller IsEnemy, not special): N = max(CountEnemyUnitsInArea(strategy, area, false), 1); skip when N x ref > 2 x lift or candidates < N. Otherwise (special or not enemy-held): N = 1 + CountEnemyUnitsInArea(.., true) over neighbour areas whose controller is an enemy, minus 1 for each of our land units with army_role != 0 already in the area's region group, each land unit we lent the controller (+0x290) there, and each land unit with role != 0 of our invasions whose objective is in that group; the supply use of all of them summed into S; N capped at 5 (special) or 20; skip when N < 1. (4) Landing: enemy area, or one with no port -> PickInvasionLandingProvince(ai, area, 0) (null skips); capacity = NavalBaseCapacity(it) + for every port q of the area (the landing port among them) within ProvinceDistanceSquared < 160000.0: floor(((1.0 - d2/160000.0) x cap(q)/1000 + 0.0005) x 1000). Friendly area with ports: the port minimising DistanceBetweenProvinces(true capital, port) x 3000 / level_current (the distance itself at level 0), capacity = the sum of the friendly ports' NavalBaseCapacity, or the chosen port's own where it is not friendly. N' = N, x3 where the area is an enemy major's acting capital area and not special. (5) Divisions, one at a time while picked < N' and S <= capacity + 2000: the candidate minimising NavalDistance(first port of its area, landing)/1000, halved for army_role 7, doubled for 4, doubled again when its weight would take the total past lift (an AI country skips such a unit); not one whose destination is already in the area's region group, not army_role 3 or 5 for an enemy area. S += its SupplyConsumption; total and smallest weight kept. (6) Enemy area and total > lift: agent +0x36C += (total - lift)/(transport_ship capability/1000) + 1; total > 2 x lift abandons the area. picked < 1, or enemy area and picked < N: agent +0x370 += N - picked. (7) Fleets: escort target = 0.5 x total; repeat while chosen lift < total or escort power < target: a fleet every ship of which has strength share >= 0.75 and organisation share >= 0.8; d = NavalDistance(its province, landing)/1000 + 500; with transport ships it is a transport candidate while chosen lift < total, without them an escort while escort power < target, d x100 with a submarine, /3 with a carrier, else /2 with a battleship; the nearest of each is taken, escort power += GetPower(fleet)/1000 for both. (8) At least one transport fleet and chosen lift >= the smallest division's weight: new CAIInvasion(&ai->tag, landing, ai), pushed on +0x50, AddUnit for every division, transport and escort (each taken off the candidate lists), slot 7, slot 52 (Enable). Worker thread. **The friendly branch seen in play 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): Britain's invasion of France's area (special, holding Paris) lands at Cherbourg, the port nearest London, with the 1st Royal Marines alone - the home area well ported, so no other division spare - and two fleets. **Seen 2026-11-15** (section 100): the Soviet Union at 04:00 on 17 July 1941, 50 candidates and a lift of 40 against a reference of 40, lands the 195. Strelkovaya Diviziya at Trondheim (291) with the Pacific and Red Banner Baltic fleets; its AddUnit sets the division's +0x198, which takes it out of Smolensk HQ's lists (CAIUnit_ManageSubordinates walks past a unit whose nearest agent is another) until the invasion ends within the hour.
addresses.evidence: The spare's loop read on the listing; CAIInvasion's constructor and AddUnit logged on the running game for all countries over 16-17 July 1941; the planner's N, reference, lift and candidates logged at 0x492C22 rva.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas
addresses.comment: **Rebuilds the ranked areas to invade at CEU3AI +0xC8** (nodes {area, score, distance, prev +0xC, next +0x10, byte +0x14}, kept by descending score through 0x49C240). Read whole, 0x895530 to `ret 8` at 0x8971B2. The list is freed first; nothing more unless UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(country units +0xBAC) >= 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. Candidates: an AI country takes every area (CCountry +0xD30) of every country in its enemies list (+0x1008) that is in_scenario, the area not landlocked - except that GER, when COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea (0x7FD90) says its acting capital's area borders an enemy, considers only NOR, SWE, FIN, DEN; and when both we and the enemy are in a real faction (slot 7), never FIN and never the acting capital area of ROM, BUL or YUG. With an agent: the areas of the agent unit's plan objectives (CUnit +0x234) that are real, not ours, held by a friend or an enemy, not landlocked and holding none of the agent's front provinces (+0xC0). Reach: our areas, plus every non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) country's areas unless our capital's area borders an enemy; range 2000 if it does, else 5000. For each candidate A (controller C): over its non-landlocked neighbour areas B - B ours: A 'touches us', and B (unless our acting capital's area) goes on a list of staging areas; B held by X != C where A is C's acting capital area, X a friend (IsFriend false-flag), at war with C (or REB, or an undeclared war covering B's first province), not played, in our faction where both are in real ones, B's region group not our capital's, and (X our subject, or we are not JAP and X not JAP/POL/DEN, X no one else's subject): A 'touches us' and B is a staging area. Then: A in the failed list (+0x94) skips; an AI country's A that touches us goes on the failed list; CEU3AI_MayInvadeArea false -> failed; some port of A must reach (0xD52A0, flag 0) a port q of a reach area within range (int(float(naval distance/1000)) < range), q in our area, in ENG's acting capital area, or reachable within range from one of our own ports - else failed. Score: 100001 for an area holding a priority province (+0x118); else, a small island (ports' level_max summing >= 1, < 5 provinces, no land neighbour +0x3C) gives GER -99 before 1944 and otherwise 10 x port levels + 51; C's acting capital area gives min(provinces,100) + 1, halved when C is a subject; else 1. +900 for C = GER when the Soviet Union owns provinces and has surrender progress > 300 or manpower < 90, we being major or max_ic > 100, and A GER's capital area; USA vs JAP +200 (+600 more for a small island) unless that Soviet test held; JAP: vs USA small island +600, HOL +200, PHI +100. Then g = 120 for each of the map defines GIBRALTAR_BLOCKER and SUEZ_BLOCKER whose province lies in A (ENG and USA only), plus over A's first 60 provinces: 8 x naval base level_max, +40 with victory points, +30 yielding crude oil/metal/energy/rare materials, +40 with a strategic resource (+0x18 slot 14), +5 owned by us; g / (n/20) when n/20 > 1. total = g + f; k = max(fistp(total/5), 5) (6 or more kept); score = total + MT19937Next(AI generator) % k, divided by (0x81880(A, our capital area)/200) when that is positive, rounded by fistp. Kept to 10 by dropping the tail. Then staging areas: the priority areas held by a same-side or non-hostile (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) non-enemy country are added; each not failed must pass AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen (0xD5760) (some port of our capital area reaches one of its ports while we are at war; always at peace) or goes on the failed list; one of ours needs >= 40 provinces in enemy-held neighbour areas (25 when one of them is its controller's capital area); score 500, or 10500 for a priority area, + AI-generator draw % max(fistp(score/5),5) - 5 x provinces, x2 for a controller's acting capital area; inserted with distance 0. Finally, entries scoring under the head's score / 10 are dropped from the tail. **Its draw (0x496A0B) is MT19937Next on the game state's +0x124**, the AI's generator and not the static one battles draw on (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59). **The staging step and the final cut read on the listing, 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): the priority areas are those of +0x118's provinces in first-seen order (0x495AFA); the holder test is IsSameSide or co-belligerent (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) and not IsEnemyTag, rebels skipped (0x496B42); the own-area count is of neighbours at war, rebels or under an undeclared war covering their first province (0x496D1D); s = 500.0 or 10500.0, k = max(fistp(s/5.0),5), the draw inline (0x496F5A, signed), less 5 x provinces, x2.0 for the holder's acting capital area (0x497026), fistp, distance 0. The final cut pops the tail while more than one is left. Seen: Britain at the start of Ireland1939_09_06_18 ranks France's area alone at -1926 (309 provinces), Germany's capital area failed for touching France's. **The score's arithmetic, read on the listing 2026-11-15** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 100; 0x89634E-0x896A88): every step is worked in double and stored as a float - f starts at 1.0, the subject's halving is x 0.5 and keeps the half, and each of the bonuses is added so; g starts at the blockers' 120s and takes each province's 8 x level (whole levels, as an int) and its 40, 30, 40 and 5 in turn, the 30 where any of the province's current_producing (+0x268) goods 3 to 6 - crude oil, metal, energy, rare materials - is not nought. The province counter is raised before it is tested, so it stops at 61 on a long area and is the province count on a short one; g is divided by counter / 20 (an int) only where that is above 1 - an area of 21 to 39 provinces is not scaled at all, one of 60 or more by 3. k = fistp(float(total / 5.0)), 5 unless above 5; the draw's remainder is idiv's, signed; the distance divisor is the least port distance / 200 as an int; the score is the float sum divided in double, then fistp, half to even. Seen: the Soviet Union at 04:00 on 17 July 1941 ranks Bornholm 70, Tromso's area of 108 provinces 31 and Hammerfest's 10.
